name: Backend Developer
description: Build and maintain server-side features, APIs, background jobs, and data flows with robust error handling.

name: Frontend Developer
description: Build usable, accessible, responsive interfaces and connect them cleanly to reliable backend data streams.

name: Data Analyst
description: Clean, explore, validate, and communicate patterns in structured datasets to support evidence-led decisions.

name: Software Engineer
description: Design, implement, and maintain modular software systems across desktop, server, or cloud environments with sound algorithmic trade-offs.

name: Full Stack Developer
description: Bridge interface implementation and server-side data models to deliver complete, secure end-to-end web applications.

name: Mobile Developer
description: Develop performant, battery-aware native or cross-platform applications for iOS and Android mobile devices.

name: QA Engineer
description: Design test plans, verify software quality, catch regressions, and ensure software specifications are rigorously satisfied.

name: SDET / Test Automation Engineer
description: Write automated test harnesses, CI regression suites, and infrastructure mocks to keep deployment pipelines green and reliable.

name: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate code integration, packaging, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning across cloud environments.

name: Cloud Engineer
description: Architect, provision, and maintain resilient cloud computing, storage, and networking services.

name: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Apply software engineering practices to system operations, ensuring high availability, latency budgets, and rapid incident response.

name: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: Protect systems, networks, and data by identifying vulnerabilities, implementing defense controls, and responding to security threats.

name: Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Program low-level microcontrollers and firmware to control physical hardware with strict memory and real-time execution constraints.

name: IoT Engineer
description: Connect physical sensors and edge devices to cloud telemetry pipelines using lightweight networking protocols like MQTT.

name: Systems Engineer
description: Build high-performance runtime tools, operating system interfaces, and compiled utilities using low-level languages like C, C++, or Rust.

name: Data Engineer
description: Construct reliable data pipelines, automated ETL workflows, and scalable analytical warehouses for business and AI consumption.

name: Data Scientist
description: Formulate hypotheses, train statistical predictive models, and design experiments to discover actionable insights from complex data.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Bridge data science models into production by building scalable training pipelines, inference microservices, and monitoring systems.

name: AI Engineer
description: Integrate foundation AI models, embeddings, and cognitive APIs into practical, secure production software applications.

name: Generative AI Engineer
description: Design, fine-tune, evaluate, and orchestrate multimodal generative models for text, code, image, and structured asset generation.

name: LLM Application Engineer
description: Architect robust production applications powered by Large Language Models with structured tools, state, and reliability engineering.

name: RAG Engineer
description: Build high-accuracy Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems connecting LLMs to private enterprise knowledge bases without hallucinations.

name: NLP Engineer
description: Process, classify, and extract structured knowledge from unstructured human language using computational linguistics and deep learning.

name: MLOps Engineer
description: Operationalize machine learning by automating continuous training, model registries, reproducible environments, and monitoring in production.

name: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Extract structured patterns, objects, and classifications from digital images, video streams, and spatial camera feeds.

name: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Transform operational and financial data into interactive dashboards, KPI reporting, and strategic business intelligence.

name: UI/UX Designer
description: Craft intuitive, accessible user experiences and polished digital interfaces backed by user research and design systems.

name: Product Designer
description: Own the end-to-end product experience, aligning user needs, business conversion metrics, and engineering feasibility.

name: UX Researcher
description: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability studies, and surveys to uncover core user mental models and inform product roadmap decisions.

name: Product Manager
description: Define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritize backlogs, and coordinate engineering, design, and business teams to launch features.

name: Technical Product Manager
description: Lead complex developer platforms, APIs, data infrastructure, and system services requiring deep technical literacy.

name: Business Analyst
description: Analyze business processes, gather stakeholder requirements, model workflows, and translate operational needs into technical specifications.

name: Technical Writer
description: Translate complex software architectures, APIs, and systems into crystal-clear documentation, developer guides, and tutorials.
